'''BV-1210''', or '''Beevee''' for short, was one of the serving [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that worked as waiters in the [[Cedrian Terrace]]. 

He was suspected to be secretly packaged with [[Spy/Legends|spy]] equipment to record conversations in the restaurant and relay them to the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]].
